# 140 Camps on the 3:00–4:00 sector — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

## A Transformation Station

**Where:** D & 3:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Large, freestanding 'ATS' sign · **Year:** 2026

Explore, Engage, Evolve: Transformation at A Transformation Station. Step into a space where grounded healing, interactive experiences, and playful experimentation come together. By day, join workshops in breathwork, meditation, movement, and conscious technology, or sign up for one-on-one sessions inside our climate-controlled sanctuary. By night, engage in music, salons, and participatory gatherings that blend introspection with expression. A Transformation Station is designed for those seeking real connection, personal growth, and shared exploration. We offer fewer, more intentional experiences held with care, inviting participants to slow down, tune in, and actively co-create the moment. Come as you are. Leave with something shifted.

## Airstreameri and What Not

**Where:** C & 3:45 · **From:** Genoa, NV · **Landmark:** Giant silver peace sign · **Year:** 2026

Home to Playa's Best Postcards! Come create one-of-a-kind art postcards filled with love and playa magic for the people you cherish back in the default world.

## Alchemist Bazaar

**Where:** 3:30 & D · **From:** Vancouver · **Landmark:** Medieval city wall with a Pyramid inside · **Year:** 2026

Alchemist Bazaar by PlayAlchemist is a mythic, medieval-inspired city, a living world of winding pathways, hidden courtyards, and immersive encounters. Enclosed like an ancient walled village, it invites wanderers into a realm where discovery unfolds at every turn. Pathways draw participants inward toward a central fire, the beating heart of the city, radiating ritual and connection. Within its walls, low-lit chambers, secret passages, and intimate sanctuaries reveal art, music, storytelling, and ceremony. Each space stewarded by artists offering unique expressions that blur the line between participant and creator. The Bazaar is the feminine counterpart to the Pyramid's order, a place of mystery, play, and transformation, where one may lose their way only to find something deeper.

*More: https://www.playalchemist.com/*

## Alternative Energy Zone

**Where:** 3:30 & E · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** 45' Tower with AEZ on it. · **Year:** 2026

A camp where you can come learn about how you can create a solar system to take care of your power needs large or small. 11am daily. Get a cocktail or pancakes, learn to figure draw and even get a positive attitude adjustment. We have Wifi gifted from the BM Org, shade and technical support from Solar to Excel...

*More: http://www.aez.green*

## Arctica Ice Sales - Ice Cubed

**Where:** 3:00 G Plaza @ 5:30 · **From:** Iceland · **Landmark:** Igloo · **Year:** 2026

## Armageddon Bike Camp

**Where:** 3:00 Portal & A · **From:** Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** 28 ft dome with blue/orange/yellow parachute cover · **Year:** 2026

It's not the end of the world, it's the safe word! Think Armageddon for all your bike needs. We've been providing Bike Love Bike Repair on-playa for almost 20 years, and we offer professional bike repair daily. Or fix your own bike at our Public Bike Repair station, 24x7! We also host great parties, don't miss our Wednesday afternoon Alley Cat Race and After Party with Funny Bike Demo! Our well-stocked BoozeBar opens on (polite) demand. Blend yourself a refreshing frozen beverage on our Blender Bike while you're there! Our 28ft dome 'living room' / shade structure provides the perfect hang-out space, no matter the weather. Open to visitors 24x7. Drop in any time!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/armageddonBRC*

## Astral Outpost

**Where:** 3:00 & C · **From:** London · **Landmark:** Stretch tent and Astral Outpost neon sign · **Year:** 2026

Astral Outpost is a place where the ethereal meets the earthly.

*More: https://www.astraloutpost.com/*

## Atomic Octopus

**Where:** B & 3:15 · **From:** Las Vegas · **Landmark:** Signs with camp name in front · **Year:** 2026

A friendly neighborhood dive. Pay no attention to the 30 foot steampunk atomic octopus at the back of the shade structure. Part of 404: Village Not Found.

*More: https://atomic-octopus.com*

## Baconeers

**Where:** 3:00 & D · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Spinning Bacon Fist & 12' BACONEERS light-up sign! · **Year:** 2026

Come visit the BACONEERS for BACON, BOOZE and BEATS! 5 huge parties featuring 90's Hip-Hop, break-beats, funk and more. We're cooking up more than 400 pounds of bacon this year, so come get your fix. Come pick up some rubber shoe covers all week in case it ever rains while you're out! Evening videos, karaoke and periodic bacon sightings! Sunday from 6-10 PM. Tuesday from 2-5 PM. Thursday from 2-5 PM. Friday from 7:00 - ? Hot Yoga on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday, too!

*More: http://www.thebaconeers.com*

## Baggage Check

**Where:** 3:00 & E · **From:** Seattle, WA · **Landmark:** BAGGAGE CHECK marquee and a 25' lit-up checkmark · **Year:** 2026

Check your Emotional Baggage with us. Spend time with us to create a better world for yourself! By writing down your emotional baggage you don't have to carry it with you; use that freed up emotional headspace to cultivate and connect with your future! We'll turn your emotional baggage into ashes and celebrate your newfound self-actualization at the temple burn. Stop by any time of the day or night, lounge in our super comfy dome, treat yourself to our pamper station, get out of the sun, or join a dance party in progress. We have a full slate of events every day - whether it's our Afternoon Oasis Sanctuary, Liquid Alchemy, giant Cuddle Puddle, Consent Workshop, Hypnotising Eye-Gazing Session, or a Topsy Turvy Happy Hour - we have something for you and welcome all with open arms!

## BAR MACTROPOLIS

**Where:** 3:00 & I · **From:** Oakland · **Landmark:** Large U Shaped Bar with a Light Canopy · **Year:** 2026

We are a full-service Bar. All are welcome. In the morning, we serve coffee, extra libation, and blood Mary's! For the rest of the day come by for a blended drink that you can blend with our custom-made blender or enjoy a cocktail or beer. Our music is chill and our bartenders the best!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/barmactropolis/*

## Bitchin' Braid Camp

**Where:** 3:00 G Plaza @ 3:45 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Blue Camp Sign in Front of our Shade Structure · **Year:** 2026

Come for the braids, stay for the bar parties. Please grab a partner or find one in the braiding lounge to make a plan for a style that will last the week. Braiders on hand with all the supplies and skills to get you taken care of, including mirrors to check out your sweet self on the way out. No hair? NO PROBLEM. From 10am to sunset we have have hosted bar parties, new faces, new specialty drinks, new outfits and new music every two hours. Want to be apart of our camp's 10 year tradition, head over right before sunset to grab a bevy and enjoy a special treat as the sun starts kissing those mountains. Miss you already, so swing by.

## BLACK ROCK ADVENTURES BUS STOP!

**Where:** C & 3:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Tall grey Feather Flag with a "!" on it · **Year:** 2026

Providing accessible Playa tours in our adventure rig, with room for about 10 - 13 Burners, leaving from our BUS STOP! art installation on the Playa. Tours go daily at 9am, return you to the BUS STOP! and last about 2hrs. Or meet us at camp prior to the tour! Contact us for info about special tours and pick ups/drop offs, and if you are interested in camping with us or driving tours. To find our camp - look for tall grey feather flag with a big " ! "on it! or check our website for our location closer to the Burn. Come ride with us!

*More: http://www.blackrockadventures.org*

## Black Rock Brewery

**Where:** 3:30 & A · **From:** Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** Black Rock Brewery hand painted on shade walls · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock Brewery specializes in serving home brew creations. Including dozens of varieties of beer, cider, mead, seltzer, wine and tea. We are also home to Utah Fire Tribe conclave group.

## Black Rock City Welding & Repair

**Where:** 3:30 & A · **From:** Portland · **Landmark:** 10' foot high large shade area and bright sarongs · **Year:** 2026

Welding, repair, adjustment and general tinkering help. Come on over to use our tools to repair your stuff or get our help repairing what's broken. We repair bikes and all sorts of other things. Enjoy an adult or NA beverage at the Crowbar - our shaded walk up and sit down Bar.

## Black Rock Observatory Theme Camp

**Where:** 3:00 G Plaza @ 8:15 · **From:** Portland, OR · **Landmark:** Black Rock Obs sign, telescopes, space tapestries · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock Observatory is a mobile astronomical observatory dedicated to showing people just how amazing the universe is. Started at Burning Man in 2014, we have expanded beyond the borders of Black Rock City to educational institutions and events all along the West Coast.

*More: https://www.blackrockobservatory.com*

## Black Rock Yearbook

**Where:** B & 3:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Large Black Rock Yearbook on container · **Year:** 2026

Every year at Burning Man, since 2007, we set up a professional shooting gallery and photographers to give out playa names and take your Black Rock Yearbook Photo! Hosting the archive for tens of thousands of Burners online at blackrockyearbook.com

*More: https://www.blackrockyearbook.com*

## BRC3PO (BRC 3:00 Post Office)

**Where:** 3:00 B Plaza @ 7:30 · **From:** Sebastopol, CA · **Landmark:** Giant white postbox with BRC3PO sign and red flag · **Year:** 2026

Set in a giant rural postbox, the Black Rock City 3:00 Post Office (BRC3PO) provides postal services to the citizens of Black Rock City. We offer authentic, one-on-one, creative interactions that range from the side-splittingly silly to the supremely sublime. We also provide an array of curated Burning Man postcards and postage to send those postcards anywhere in the world - as our gift to the citizens of Black Rock City.. Imagine the intersection of immersive improvisational theater, spontaneous talent show, soulful conversation, and stifling yet corrupt bureaucracy. You never know what will happen next at BRC3PO -- YOU could be what will happen next at BRC3PO, if you pay us a visit!

*More: http://www.brc3po.com*

## BRCSPCA (anti-human society)

**Where:** E & 3:45 · **From:** san francisco · **Landmark:** poppers the giant stuffed dog · **Year:** 2026

We are a small, welcoming camp focused on connection, creativity, and community care. Our central dome hosts daily interactive offerings like conversation games, pop-up workshops, and cozy lounges where anyone can drop in to chill, connect, or collaborate. Whether you're looking for a deep talk, a silly prompt, or a moment of rest, we offer a space that's low-key, low-barrier, and open to all. Come say hi, share a story, or just hang in the shade—everyone is welcome here.

## BRCvr presents BurnerSphere

**Where:** B & 3:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Black Rock Yearbook sign. · **Year:** 2026

BRCvr invited you to come play and learn about immersive technologies and storytelling. Learn about the BurnerSphere and how you can participate.

*More: https://burnersphere.com/*

## Burnstream Court

**Where:** 3:30 & E · **From:** Cloverdale · **Landmark:** 1950s lighthouse beacon high up on a scissor lift · **Year:** 2026

Burnstream Court is a group of Airstream owners who recreate a 1960s trailer park, Black Rock City style. We almost always have fun daytime events happening that you can join in with. And we give away grilled cheese sandwiches midday M-F.

*More: http://www.batmo.com/burnstream/*

## Camp Come Find Us CCFU

**Where:** B & 3:15 · **From:** Las Vegas · **Landmark:** Rainbow camp sign & flags · **Year:** 2026

Here at Camp Come Find Us (CCFU) we are a camp that is about finding yourself and exploring who you are at Burning Man. Every journey is individual and unique. Come flow with us and find your journey! We will create a laid-back and spontaneous atmosphere, and our offerings will be inspiring and fulfilling. We endeavor to create a strong community among our fellow Burners. Come find us and find yourself!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61557109851387*

## Camp Contact

**Where:** C & 3:45 · **From:** Washington, DC · **Landmark:** Long aluminet tent · **Year:** 2026

Camp Contact is dedicated to offering a more embodied world through Contact Improvisation, Acro Yoga, Ecstatic Dance, Authentic Relating, Internal Family Systems, and other Psychotechnologies. We bring a dance space and domes for our offerings! We welcome others who know of these and related practices and modalities to join us in community!

*More: https://brc.campcontact.org*

## Camp Cul-de-Sac

**Where:** C & 3:15 · **From:** Grass Valley · **Landmark:** Cinema Sign · **Year:** 2026

Our Cinema runs from Sunset to Sunrise, Tuesday through Friday. Family-friendly content 8pm-10pm. Silent Films 10pm-12am. A cornucopia of the delightful and absurd from 12am-6am. A different theme every night!

## Camp Do Nothing

**Where:** 3:00 & D · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** 360 swing · **Year:** 2026

Camp Do Nothing - the camp that's actually doing the opposite of its name! Come take in a 360 view of the playa on our swing (yep, you'll be hanging 35 feet upside down!), climb on and into the foam dome, or come have a seat and some conversation with burners from all over.

## Camp Kinetic

**Where:** 3:00 & E · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** wide open front, pointy white shade, scaffolding · **Year:** 2026

Dedicated to Movement Arts in Black Rock City. Afternoon Workshops in Flow Arts, Juggling, Dance, Yoga, and Aerial. Evening Features Performances and Fire Jams

*More: http://campkinetic.org*

## Camp Kühloff

**Where:** 3:15 & F · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** inflatable yeti! · **Year:** 2026

This year we are coming to you! Camp Kuhloff Pop-up events are happening Monday-Thursday 2pm-4pm throughout the playa where we will be passing out ice-cold lavender towels and good vibes. Be on the look out for our inflatable yeti!

*More: https://www.campkuhloff.org*

## Camp NOT a Cult!

**Where:** B & 3:45 · **From:** Flagstaff · **Landmark:** mushrooms and green aliens · **Year:** 2026

Camp Not a Cult provides an alcohol-free, sobriety-supportive space for new and experienced burners which is light-hearted, sarcastically and not culty. We believe that by removing alcohol from our lives we have unlocked a way to live more authentically, feel better, and have more FUN every single day. And that doesn't make us boring. You still find us howling at the moon, wild-eyed and sometimes naked, dancing around the fire. Rather than daily recovery meetings, we offer a variety of yoga and meditation classes and workshops, a cacao ceremony & ecstatic dance, a fire-spinning workshop for beginners, Ayurvedic wisdom, 1-2 sober/sober-curious meetups, and other events. All these events will be open to the community.

## CatLand

**Where:** D & 3:45 · **From:** Sacramento · **Landmark:** Free WiFi robot art & cat silhouette flare · **Year:** 2026

Burning Man's haven for feline enthusiasts. Join us for themed parties featuring tacos, late night hotdogs, kareoke and craft activities all centered around our beloved cats. Indulge in our open bar, where camaraderie flows as freely as the drinks. We promise you a purrr-fect escape into our feline universe. Experience magic of CatLand, where the spirit of Burning Man meets the playful spirit of cats.

## Chatterbox Camp

**Where:** A & 3:15 · **From:** Salt Lake CIty · **Landmark:** Chatterbox Dome with Signage · **Year:** 2026

Immerse yourself in the vibrant cacophony of creativity with the Chatterbox Art Car. This rolling masterpiece serves as a mobile platform for spontaneous conversations, fueled by the energy of the playa. Adorned with mesmerizing humans and pulsating with music, the Chatterbox invites participants to engage in dynamic dialogues, forging connections that transcend boundaries. Join the journey aboard this mobile marvel and experience the magic of community, expression, laughter and exploration!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/chatterbox_art_car/*

## Coffee and Pasties

**Where:** B & 3:45 · **From:** Marin County · **Landmark:** Our gorgeous fire pit out front for all to enjoy! · **Year:** 2026

Bringing organic peculator coffee / nitro cold brew back the Playa with great things to add like Whiskey or Irish cream and of course all the colorful pasties! And please come sit by our fire!

## Cosmic Giggle

**Where:** 3:00 & E · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** 30' Bundt Dome (day) and 84' LED Beacon (nite) · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Cosmic Giggle! We are burners spanning from NYC to the Bay and crossing continents to London and Beirut. Our name is inspired by an experimental documentary that explores the expansive energy field that we, together, create...and one thing is for sure, it can get pretty random! Here's what we have in store for you this year: We've got a gym! Who said being Playa meant missing out on your pump up? We've got classes! We work out your externals, navigate your internals, and will get you giggling! We've got a bar! Rehydrate with electrolytes. Dehydrate with booze. Though beware: we may make you work for it! Looking to keep your heart rate mellow? We've got cosmic croquet and an oasis lounge. OH, and meet Freddy, our resident GODZILLA! So come on: Enter our cosmic chaos. Have a Giggle!

*More: http://cosmicgiggle.org*

## Cuttlefish Homebase

**Where:** E & 3:15 · **From:** Santa Rosa · **Landmark:** Inflatable cuttlefish · **Year:** 2026

Come find the Cuttlefish (and Flash the Tortoise) back at their lair and say hi!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/cuttlefishartcar*

## Dark Heart

**Where:** 3:30 & D · **From:** Laramie · **Landmark:** 14 ft lighted arch w/ a red stretch tent behind it · **Year:** 2026

Morning community dance followed by small, intimate heart-share pods? Incredible afternoon expansive workshops? Sunset rituals? Fire art? Fire DANCE?!? Nightly temple celebrations of intimacy and joy? Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes! Start with our Cafe on the Edge, where you can look forward into the mystery and consider what you're going to leave behind. Take the leap into our Dark Temple, where you can plug into the void and remember what all-is-love really feels and looks like and how to bring that heaven to the heart of the playa - you! Come drop in with our camp of experienced, international burners who are focused on creating a loving, tight community and flowing the love out to all of you BRC citizens! We love you!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/darkheartcamp*

## DeMentha

**Where:** 3:00 Portal & A · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Two DeMentha signs at the corners of our frontage · **Year:** 2026

Mojitos, Music, Shade, Mist & Dancing served up with a warm DeMentha welcome.

*More: http://www.dementha.com*

## Dilla's Den

**Where:** F & 3:15 · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** 2 large armadillo profiles · **Year:** 2026

We support the Quesadilla Armadilla mutant vehicle so that she is good to go for playa exploring and artistic photo ops. You can often find us randomly at sound cars in deep playa serving quesadillas at sunrise. The Dilla's Den is where we rest and recharge and you can come by to dilla dally with us anytime. See you in the dust.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/quesadilla_armadilla/*

## Dome Sweet Dome

**Where:** D & 3:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Large shade structure with 20" mast w flag & light · **Year:** 2026

A group of long time burners happy to be in Black Rock City. Come by and visit and check out our Mutant Vehicles.

## DUSTFISH

**Where:** Esplanade & 3:45 · **Landmark:** Red bar and red shade with a crane behind. · **Year:** 2026

DUSTFISH, serving Love and Pho all week.

*More: http://dustfish.org*

## Dustmight

**Where:** C & 3:15 · **From:** Vancouver · **Landmark:** Pink "Dustmight X Voxelite" neon-style sign · **Year:** 2026

Art support camp for Voxelite, a volumetric light sculpture. Previous projects have included Popstar, the mobile popcorn stand!

*More: https://dustmight.camp/*

## Dusty Bunnies

**Where:** B & 3:15 · **From:** Portland · **Landmark:** Big sign that says Dusty Bunnies · **Year:** 2026

Camp Dusty Bunnies - get a new outfit at the Boutique, taste strange foods at Bunny's Deli, dance and mingle with your new best friends in our Lounge. Plus, watch for Bunny's Pop-up Bistro to randomly appear on the Playa.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/DustyBunnyBoutique*

## Dusty Taint

**Where:** 3:00 B Plaza @ 2:30 · **From:** Buffalo · **Landmark:** Arched military tent, lit up DUSTY TAINT letters · **Year:** 2026

Dusty Taint Juke Joint is the Shadiest Bar in Town! Inspired by 1940s Negro Juke Joints, our space blends music, games, nostalgia, and drinks...where passersby can unwind on the porch or in our cozy neighborhood style bar. More than a party-its a refuge from crazy weather. Its multi-cultural, sexually diverse gathering that sparks conversations and new friendships. Vibe out on the porch. Dance to some curated playlists. Toast to connection and authenticity. Cards, darts, games, and themed gatherings keep the vibe lively in a relaxed, informal setting. In a world of hate and noise, we stand for authenticity, love, and unity, celebrating cultures, embracing differences, and learning from one another. At Dusty Taint Juke Joint, we don't just party...we strive to build a better Burning Man community.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/dustytaintofficial*

## Eitherlight

**Where:** E & 3:15 · **From:** San Juan · **Landmark:** hanging lanterns on each corner of the perimeter · **Year:** 2026

A place to dream and connect with light lovers and sonic connoisseurs.

## Empire of Dirt

**Where:** A & 3:45 · **From:** Oakland, California · **Landmark:** Large and obvious metal sign "Empire of Dirt" · **Year:** 2026

At Empire of Dirt, we don't just build mutant vehicles...we launch dreams into orbit. Our camp is a hub of performance, creativity, collaboration, and full-on playa absurdity. We're proud to be a returning Burning Man camp based in Oakland, California, with a long tradition of mobile art, DIY ethics, and radical participation. Interactivity is Our Mission

*More: https://formandreform.com/empire-of-dirt/*

## Erotic Inclination Photo Studio

**Where:** 3:00 & I · **From:** Union City · **Landmark:** Erotic posters on black shade walls and EIPS sign · **Year:** 2026

Step into the realm of sensual allure: Swing by to EIPS (Erotic Inclination Photo Studio) to create one of a kind photo memory of yourself and your loved one with the help of our resident photo artist. Singles, couples, and groups are welcome to experience unique photoshoots on the outskirts of Black Rock City, where the good old Razorback Mountain sits patiently, providing a stunning natural backdrop for the art you’re about to create using nothing but your body and the unique light of the high desert. We will provide a discrete environment to have your intimate photos taken in our photo tent or you can choose a photo session outside in the walk-in camping area catching the light of the golden hour of the late afternoon. All walk-ins are welcome! Hours: Mon – Fri, 9:30 – 5

*More: https://www.facebook.com/Erotic.Inclination*

## ESD Station 3:00

**Where:** 3:00 & C · **From:** Nordland · **Landmark:** 3 & C Look for the Fire House facade & the Heart · **Year:** 2026

ESD Station 3 supports the Medical station at 3 & C, it is also the home to the Black Rock City Fire Department. For 25 Years "Fire Camp" has been the playa home for ourESD Fire, HazMat, Tech Rescue and medical volunteers.

## Fast & Bi-Curious

**Where:** B & 3:45 · **From:** Oakland · **Landmark:** Ice cold beer flag · **Year:** 2026

At Fast & Bi-Curious, you can have any ice cold beer you want, as long as it's a Corona. Stop in for an ice cold Corona (non-alcoholic available) and watch our favorite film series with us.

## Fatwatt

**Where:** B & 3:45 · **From:** Austin · **Landmark:** Fatwatt camp sign and Ego Death electric chair · **Year:** 2026

Experience Ego Death, an interactive electric chair.

## Fjörgyn's Lair

**Where:** F & 3:15 · **From:** Carson City · **Landmark:** White work truck bed, turned into fuel trailer · **Year:** 2026

The Viking Longboat was a potent symbol of life, livelihood, one's journey through life, the afterlife, and was used by the Norse for transport, in trade, in warfare, and as a burial vessel for centuries. Fjorgyn is a personification of earth in Norse mythology, and the mother of the thunder god Thor, the son of Odin.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/00FoF00*

## Flock of Donkeys

**Where:** F & 3:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Black shade w/ chandelier, Flock of Donkeys flag · **Year:** 2026

## Gaian Airship

**Where:** D & 3:15 · **From:** Ibiza and New York · **Landmark:** Flying Gaian Airship above Future Ashram pyramid · **Year:** 2026

An immersive journey into the thriving future. We play a game to create a unifying vision of the thriving future around the Time, Water, Fire, Air and Earth elements.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/gaianairhip*

## Gallavant

**Where:** 3:00 G Plaza @ 10:30 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Large Pier Sign with Gallavant across the top · **Year:** 2026

Ahoy from the Pirates of the Playa (infamous creators of the oldest pirate ship on the playa the USS Nevada)?look for us "Gallavanting" around the playa spreading fun and adventure and hop a ride with us! ! Our mighty USS Nevada will be doing 2+ tours around playa daily from our home port so come visit us, enjoy our signature grogs concocted with rum in an awesome full-fledged pirate bar, The ArrghBar. pARTicipate in our 2+ daily theme parties 10am and 2pm, come get your drink on, play games, and then relax in our Pirates Den ? an amazing chill space with couches. Visit our Wayward Wenches Bazaar, because we got what you forgot. Come party with us....It's sure to be an adventure.

*More: https://www.Gallavant.us*

## Glowskull Asylum Int'l

**Where:** 3:00 Portal & A · **From:** Santa Cruz · **Landmark:** Flame-shaped led streetlights along the frontage · **Year:** 2026

Glowskull Asylum Int'l brings extreme metal radical inclusion to the playa. Are you craving some good headbanging and want to meet exotic misfits from random places all over the world? Our bar, Skøllushery, and art car "Castle Glowskull" will be hosting mischief, ultra-violence, and twisted METAL (and other deranged forms of terrible music) daily. All varieties of humans welcome!

## Grateful Burners

**Where:** 3:30 & B · **From:** Bay Area, CA · **Landmark:** Large wooden sign with Grateful Burners name · **Year:** 2026

Grateful Burners - your neighborhood pit stop. We're serving up mid-day iced coffee and providing a high-pressure "Dust-Off" station for weary travelers. Come evening, relax in our shaded plaza for classic concert videos (i.e. Marley, Dead, Talking Heads, Pink Floyd etc.) and chill visuals.

## Gravity

**Where:** 3:30 & F · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** An elevated sign that says < < GRAVITY >> · **Year:** 2026

Camp Gravity sets sail to the heart of the sea through art installations, activities, and workshops. We make our space to be fun and engaging as well as an amazing place to dance with top notch music! Visit us!

*More: https://www.gravitycamp.org/*

## Gypsy Monkey Carnival

**Where:** 3:00 & F · **From:** GRANTS PASS · **Landmark:** 20' tall Madam Zelda with her welcoming embrace. · **Year:** 2026

Gypsy Monkey Carnival welcomes you! Come and adopt a mutant monkey, play games, and win prizes. You can ride the biggest cock on the playa. The Gypsy Monkey Carnival lounge is shady during the day and black-lighted at night, and always welcomes the weary traveler to rest and enjoy our ambiance and snark.

## Hack-a-Cola

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 3:00 · **From:** Gerlach · **Landmark:** red shade, brick wall facade, Hack-a-Cola sign · **Year:** 2026

A visit to Hack-a-Cola is a reprieve from the heat empowered by a sampling of a wide variety of unique, handcrafted flavors of soda. Hand us a cup and we'll mix cold carbonated water with one or more of our syrups to make a refreshing soda on the spot. We may even put a scoop of ice cream in your soda to make it a float! We tweak our recipes and invent new flavors throughout the week. Inquisitive visitors can learn how to fulfill their own soda making dreams with the guidance of our knowledgeable, helpful soda jerks. We aim to provide a welcoming space where everyone will feel comfortable to stay a while and enjoy the company under our plentiful shade. You may see our food truck, The Purple People Feeder, in our camp or out and about on the playa.

## Happy Hour

**Where:** 3:30 & A · **From:** Sacramento · **Landmark:** Cubish in Front 10x10 room will be on the frontage · **Year:** 2026

Hard day on the playa? Unwind at Happy Hour, where you'll be greeted by one of a kind refreshing spirits served with smiles! Enjoy our lounge, bar, and dance floor! Start your day with Happy Hour!
